title: Upload Row
description: One row = one (tile, metric_definition, metric_value) tuple. Field names follow the `entity.attribute` convention from App\Services\Export\FieldWhitelist so the row shape is symmetric with the JSON export.

tile.id.description: Ignored on import; tenant-local IDs are regenerated.

tile.slug.description: URL-safe de-slug; natural key of the tile within the tenant.

tile.title.description: Required on create. de locale required, en optional.

category.labels.description: Ignored on import; informational only (comes from export).

category.groups.description: Ignored on import; informational only (comes from export).

metric.key.description: Required if any value.* fields are set. Unique per tile.

metric.source.description: Reserved for a post-follow-up. Accepted but currently not persisted.

metric.source_url.description: Reserved. Accepted but currently not persisted.

metric.methodology.description: Reserved. Accepted but currently not persisted.

metric.formula.description: Reserved. Accepted but currently not persisted.

value.year.description: Calendar year; the natural key of a value, symmetric with the export. Required if value.value is set. v1 is year-only: it maps internally to a year-granularity TimePeriod (period_key = the 4-digit year). Sub-year granularities (quarter/month/week/day) are a planned v1.1 extension and are not accepted in v1.

allOf.description: If value.value is provided, value.year and metric.key are required.

oneOf.description: Accepted as plain text (e.g. from CSV round-trip). Will be wrapped into {de: value} during import based on bundle.locale.
